Name: Huldah, Prophetess
Summary: Huldah the prophetess, wife of Shallum keeper of the wardrobe, told Josiah's messengers that Jerusalem would indeed face the curses of the book, but because Josiah's heart was tender he would be gathered to his grave in peace.
KeyStory: Huldah confirms judgment and promises Josiah peace.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Hilkiah, High Priest; Shallum, Husband of Huldah
LifeLesson: A tender heart does not cancel judgment, but it does find mercy within it.
